notes.title: If you experience excessive Adobe Popups, Contact US
notes.content:
Good day, Friends and Family of Goodnight Butcher.  Goodnight Butcher is a flash game you should receive one popup asking “permission for the flash player to store local content;” this allows the game to save your progress.  Without this feature, you would have to start over every time.   If you continuously see this or any popup, please take a screenshot and send it to sam@perfectsquarestudios.com and we will research the cause of the pop-ups.  
Thank you for your help.
~ Perfect Square Studios

notes.title: Technical Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your feedback and suggestions. We pushed out an update last night that solved a couple issues, and implemented some enhancements.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Now when you hit Play, the game launches immediately and doesn't ask you to install the game every time.
    [*]The game tracks time correctly when you launch it from Steam. If you've installed the game onto your desktop from the old installer, we recommend uninstalling that version. 
[/list]
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The game now launches in full screen mode. This hides the border window around the game and makes it more immersive. 
    [*]We've added a Quit button to the main menu. You have to navigate to it with the arrow keys and press space bar. 
[/list]
Best Regards, 
- Sam n' Xan

notes.title: Thanks and Trading Cards soon!
notes.content:
Goodnight Butcher has been out for 2 days and we wanted to thank everyone for the warm welcome and all the support we've received. We're very proud to have the opportunity to share our game with such a great community.

Steam trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and such are in the works!
- Xan

If you experience any issues at all, please contact me and I'll be happy to personally help you.
- Sam
